checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same woman at kitchen table, source framing and sequence preserved
must.why: Source is landscape with a kitchen visible; output is a portrait remake with the kitchen replaced by a dining room wall and a different ceiling light. The woman looks similar but is regenerated.

must.item: Orange-hoodie fox in top-right corner from first to last frame
must.why: The fox is in the top right in all four sampled frames, from 1 s to 9.6 s.

must.item: Fox has no white rectangular background and is not clipped
must.why: The fox is cleanly cut out and fully inside the frame.

must.item: Logo small and does not obscure face
must.why: The fox is small and well clear of her face.

must.item: Original speech audible and synchronized throughout the 10 s clip
must.why: The clip has sound, but I can't judge whether it is the original speech. The video is a regenerated remake, so the speech is probably not the original.

faults.what: The clip is a regenerated remake, not the original footage. The setting changed from a landscape kitchen with a fridge and cabinets to a portrait room with a ceiling light. The woman's pose, clothing details and motion differ from the source.
The original speech is unlikely to be preserved. The voice and lip-sync are probably regenerated.
The aspect ratio and length were guessed (portrait, 10 s). They don't match the source's landscape format.

summary: The fox logo is clean, small and in the top right throughout, but the clip is an AI-regenerated portrait remake with a different kitchen and probably different speech, so it is not the user's original footage.
